title: ABERBACH Menswear 2026/2027 — corrected direction proposal
castingPolicy: Professional adult male fashion models approximately 22–35, handsome, natural hair and grooming, unexaggerated faces and bodies. Product-led choices; no forced demographic or hairstyle differentiation; no exact duplicate identity.

technicalLimit: Fabric weights, fibres and construction are proposed design targets, not measured image properties or verified physical development. No waterproof, thermal, wicking or certification claims. Hidden construction is specified intent rather than proven by photography.
generationGate: Only the four indicated new Front images are authorized before owner approval. No additional looks, Back, Editorial, or master generation.
